gloss: Runs down through the gland deep to the facial nerve.
role: Inside the gland the nerve usually lies on the outer side of a large vein, which scans use to estimate where the nerve runs.
matters: The retromandibular vein runs down through the gland and marks the division between its deep and superficial lobes, so it approximates the depth of the facial nerve. The lower division of the nerve usually lies lateral (superficial) to it.
